title: Vertical Projectile Motion
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A projectile launched upward has height s(t) = -16t^2 + 96t + 112 feet. Find its maximum height and impact velocity.
finalAnswer: \text{Max height: } 256 \text{ ft at } t = 3 \text{ s}; \quad \text{Impact velocity: } -128 \text{ ft/s at } t = 7 \text{ s}

steps.title: Find Velocity Function
steps.why: Velocity is the derivative of position.

steps.title: Find Time of Maximum Height
steps.explanation: The projectile peaks when upward velocity reaches zero.
steps.why: Peak occurs at v = 0 before reversal.

steps.title: Find Ground Impact Time and Velocity
steps.explanation: Solve s(t) = 0 for positive t, then compute v(7).
